title: Genesis
tagline: GENESIS lets you create 3D worlds with AI. Type a prompt, and the game generates environments, stories, and NPCs, bringing your mystery to life with immersive visuals, depth mapping, and interactive AI-driven characters.
description:
The Genesis is an immersive AI-driven game that empowers players to create and shape their own unique worlds. Using advanced AI, players can craft landscapes, civilizations, and ecosystems from scratch, tailoring every aspect of their environment.

AI-Driven World Building: Players generate custom worlds using AI, defining terrain, climate, cultures, and species.
NPC Interactions: In-game characters can be  interacted.
Tradable Assets: NFTs obtained in the game are fully tradable on blockchain marketplaces, adding real-world value.
Evolving Lore: Each player's world has a self-sustaining narrative, evolving based on their interactions and decisions.
how_its_made: The Genesis uses GaiaNet for AI-driven world generation and Privy for Web3 login. The AI generates dynamic landscapes, models skyboxes with cube mapping, and adjusts 3D model positions and rotations. In-game characters evolve based on player interactions. The game integrates blockchain for tradable NFTs as rewards. The tech stack blends Phaser for game mechanics, AI for procedural world building, and blockchain for secure asset trading.
